subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Noble
solution:
The correct answer is: **Dignified**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Noble **means having or showing fine personal qualities or high moral principles. (महान)

 
 
• **Example**: *The knight displayed noble traits, always putting the needs of others before his own.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Dignified **means having or showing a composed or serious manner that is worthy of respect. (अभिमानी)
 
 
• **Example**: *Even in challenging situations, she maintained a dignified composure, earning the respect of those around her.*
 
 
 
• Synonyms of noble include honourable, virtuous, and gallant.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Agile **means being able to move quickly and easily. (फुर्तीली)
 
• **Regular **means arranged in or constituting a constant or definite pattern. (सामान्य)
 
• **Humble **means having a modest or low estimate of one's importance. (विनम्र)
